notes: Baseline generated with mgbdis commit 95d951a9881a0d7ff1a42a94d1be175da92b1777 and RGBDS v1.0.4.
MBC2 ROM bank selection writes to $2100. The selected bank is cached at HRAM $FFA2; $FFA3 stores one previous bank for the paired restore RST.
The generated mgbdis source is a bootstrap: many non-code regions are still represented as instructions and must not be interpreted without evidence.
VBlank copies the HRAM shadow block at $FF9A-$FFA1 into LYC/LCDC/IE/SCY/SCX/WY/WX, runs bank 3 and bank 15 callbacks, restores the cached ROM bank, and increments $FFA8.
The ten bytes at Bank 00:$2DAB-$2DB4 are copied to HRAM $FF80-$FF89 and perform OAM DMA from WRAM $C000.
The primary font is compressed at Bank 1:$5D3B-$6198 and therefore was not visible in whole-bank raw tile scans. It expands to 160 packed 1bpp 8x8 glyphs and is uploaded to signed tile IDs $00-$9F.
Bank 00 is mapped in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_000.md. Broad gameplay ranges are documented by subsystem without speculative semantic names.
The MBC2 save format stores each logical byte as two low-nibble RAM cells. Slots begin at $A004 and $A102, encode 126 bytes each, and use an 8-bit nibble-sum checksum.

Bank 00:$322D-$32D5 includes command parsing and message resolution. 00:329F resolves IDs through bank-3 pointer tables rooted at 03:4000; 03:7E00 consumes the resulting encoded stream during VBlank and writes tile IDs to the tilemap.
Bank 00 includes confirmed non-code/table-heavy ranges, especially $27D4-$2866 and $3E72-$3F69; generated instruction mnemonics there must not be treated as executable evidence.

Bank 3:$4000-$7BD6 (ROM $0C000-$0FBD6) is encoded message pointer/data storage and is explicitly declared as dw/db data. Bank 3:$7BD7-$7DFF is confirmed zero padding; the VBlank interpreter begins at 03:7E00 (ROM $0FE00).

The primary font tile map is recorded in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/font_tiles.tsv; bank-3 direct/composite stream bytes through $E1 are recorded in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/text_encoding.tsv and can be decoded with tools/bin/gb-text-decode.

Bank-3 text enumeration finds 479 pointer-table references to 419 unique streams. The script-free reference index is projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank3_text_reference_index.tsv; the local decoded catalog is projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank3_text_tables.tsv, with methodology in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_003_text.md.
The five-character title subtitle and four post-START menu labels are fixed Bank 2 2bpp tile strips, not reusable 16x16 kanji font text; see projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/title_screen_graphics.md.

Bank 2 is fully classified. A 20-entry table at $4A4C selects 13 unique gap-free compressed graphics streams through $6C8C; presentation object/layout records continue through $7132, title/menu code occupies $7133-$726F, and a nested pointer-selected scenario/UI data module occupies $7300-$7E30. Exact zero padding fills $7270-$72FF and $7E31-$7FFF; see projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_002.md.
Bank 3 is fully classified. The VBlank text interpreter ends at $7FA2 and is followed by 93 exact zero bytes at $7FA3-$7FFF.

Banks 0 and 1 are fully classified. Bank 0 contains fixed interrupt, state, gameplay, rendering, graphics-loading, and UI infrastructure with explicitly retained embedded tables. Bank 1 combines SGB presentation data, the primary font, a broad gameplay/UI module with embedded resources, a 96-byte auxiliary graphics copy source at $7F3D, and zero padding from $7F9D; see projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_000.md and bank_001.md.

Bank 4 and Bank 5:$4000-$5992 contain the catalog and compressed 560-byte graphics resources loaded by 00:3784/00:3879. Direct pointers, shared streams, derived-resource descriptors, auxiliary tiles, stream boundaries, and padding are documented in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/banks_004_005_graphics.md.

Bank 6 contains the primary and secondary large-graphics descriptor catalogs, seven alias-selected tile-index layouts, compressed streams for IDs $00-$13, and trailing zero padding. Banks 7-10 complete primary IDs $14-$75; Banks 11-12 contain the 33 secondary streams. Banks 7-12 end in confirmed zero padding. Exact source-bank partitions, shape resolution, stream boundaries, and output sizes are documented in projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/banks_006_012_graphics.md.

Bank 13:$4000-$6FFF contains three exact 4 KiB Super Game Boy border-transfer pages submitted as PCT_TRN, PCT_TRN parameter $01, and CHR_TRN; see projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_013_sgb_transfer.md.

Bank 13:$7000-$75A3 completes a gapless sequence of seven compressed mode resources consumed by 0D:75A4; the first two streams begin inside the SGB transfer pages, demonstrating intentional source-range reuse.

Bank 13:$75A4-$7F9E is a banked mode loader/gameplay module with embedded pointer and object-initialization tables; $7F9F-$7FFF is confirmed zero padding. See projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_013_mode.md.

Bank 5:$5993-$79B2 contains pointer-selected command/display data, presentation and selection routines, three decoder-confirmed compressed graphics streams, object/layout data, and a tilemap; $79B3-$7FFF is confirmed zero padding. See projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_005_presentation.md.

Bank 14 contains the primary mode entered at $4000, exact raw tilemap/graphics sources at $4B20/$4B70/$5270, lookup/map/object data through $6DCA, a secondary editor/state-transform module through $7461, and zero padding from $7462. See projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_014_mode.md.

Bank 15 is the audio subsystem. Entry $4000 processes sound commands, entry $4003 is called once per VBlank and jumps to the update routine at $4222, and data from $4B42 onward is selected through in-bank pointers. See projects/gb-db-z-gokou/analysis/bank_015_audio.md.
